The '''Palawa Band''' was a [[Teräs Käsi/Legends|Teräs Käsi]] championship held in the settlement of [[Äslajä]] on [[Bunduki/Legends|Bunduki]],<ref name="JDfTKT">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|55|sports/1359_1.html|Jedi Defeated for Teräs Käsi Title}}</ref> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] on which the [[Followers of Palawa]] taught<ref name="TCSWEIII231">{{CSWECite|III|231|teräs käsi}}</ref> and practiced the martial art.<ref name="TCSWEI284">{{CSWECite|I|284|Followers of Palawa}}</ref><ref name="TCSWEI97">{{CSWECite|I|97|Bunduki}}</ref> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], [[Joclad Danva/Legends|Joclad Danva]], a member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], was defeated by Bunduki native [[Phow Ji]] in the finals of the tournament.<ref name="JDfTKT" />
